newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 364-day t-bill average yield 6.459 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 364-day t-bill average yield 6.459 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.459 percent at its auction of 364-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit.
At its previous auction of 364-day treasury bills on May 22 for a similar amount, the average yield was 6.457 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.469/449 percent against 6.500/399 percent previously.
Bank Negara said it will hold the next auction of 91-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit and 182-day bills for a similar amount on June 12.
